m2-instrument-4-and-report.imperative: Wire Instrument 4: (a) the position-sum construction identity via a synthetic nest_sectors tiling (pure, mirrors tests/unit/physics/instrument_panel/test_sector_scorecard.py's own demonstration) -- PASS/FAIL reported plainly; (b) judge and STATE PLAINLY whether the real on-disk slice (corner-severity CLASS grain, a time-share partition of the whole lap, no class->FIA-sector assignment on disk) can compose a genuine per-FIA-sector prediction -- it cannot (no telemetry-derived segment tiling in this DB-only slice) -- and route that gap to #670 explicitly, never fabricating a per-sector number; (c) report whatever calibration IS computable: a WHOLE-LAP (not per-sector) composed prediction per driver x circuit via compose_sector_predictions with a single pseudo-sector spanning the 6 real per-class SegmentPredictions (mu = reference_laps class time-share x constructor lap_time_s + the driver's own time_deficit_s; sigma = a stated, honestly-labeled leave-one-circuit-out cross-circuit SEM proxy of the driver's own class deficit; n_eff = n_points), scored via score_sector/compute_observed_coverage/size_calibration against the official best-lap TOTAL time (sum of 3 real FIA sector times from data/f1_data_2023.db lap_times) using the frozen SECTOR_CALIB_* triple -- report the gross-miscalib gate result. Then assemble the FULL versioned markdown report (header with issue/date/slice identity/exact frozen constants used/the SIZING-panel-never-gates banner; all four instruments' results; the small-signal-is-expected note; the bounded-scope note) written to docs/physics/instrument_panel_668_gb2023q_report.md, plus a machine-readable JSON (state in the report whether it is committed or local-only). Deterministic (seed any RNG). Attest c1 before the command check.
